description: Build the evidence matrix and GO decision table artifacts, and plot the exclusion structure of the substrate argument
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

EV=[
("42832562","mutant phenotype (allele replacement)","supports",
 "RTT109 acetyltransferase catalysis is required for PRC2-repressed chromatin",
 "rtt109 D145A and rtt109 D145A-DD304-305AA at csr-1 in delta-rtt109 fail to rescue H3K27me3; loss equal to or greater than delta-rtt109; wild-type rtt109-3xflag rescues",
 "N. crassa, vegetative hyphae, H3K27me3 ChIP-seq + western",
 "High for the requirement. Authors note catalytic-dead protein levels were reduced, so a protein-abundance contribution is not formally excluded."),
("42832562","mutant phenotype (histone point mutant)","refutes H3K56ac as the relevant product",
 "H3K56ac is the product that supports PRC2-repressed chromatin",
 "hH3 K56R and hH3 K56Q do not phenocopy the delta-rtt109 H3K27me3 defect; global H3K27me3 unchanged by western; only modest bidirectional ChIP-seq profile shifts",
 "N. crassa, hH3 point-mutant strains",
 "High. Both alleles are MMS-hypersensitive, an internal positive control that they perturb H3K56 function."),
("42832562","interaction + mutant phenotype","refutes the Vps75 route",
 "The NAF-2 (Vps75) dependent route produces the relevant mark",
 "NAF-2 is the top RTT109 co-IP LC-MS/MS interactor of 11; AlphaFold3 ipTM 0.67 with 20 contacts between RTT109 420-480 and NAF-2 290-330; delta-naf-2 does not reproduce the H3K27me3 defect",
 "N. crassa, FLAG co-IP and deletion strains",
 "High for dispensability. The interaction is real but uncoupled from the phenotype."),
("42832562","interaction (negative)","qualifies",
 "ASF-1 partners with RTT109 in N. crassa",
 "No RTT109-ASF-1 interaction detected; authors attribute this to the known difficulty of detecting Asf1-Rtt109 without crosslinking in yeast",
 "N. crassa co-IP LC-MS/MS",
 "Low. A negative co-IP under non-crosslinking conditions does not exclude the interaction."),
("42832562","coverage audit of the primary article (this work)","qualifies",
 "An alternative acetylation site was identified",
 "Zero occurrences of H3K9ac, H3K14ac, H3K18ac, H3K23ac or H3K27ac in 120,120 characters of full text; no acetylome or histone-PTM mass spectrometry reported",
 "Text mining of PMCID 13652317 via NCBI efetch",
 "High as a statement about the article. The alternative substrate is defined only by exclusion."),
("24554705","direct assay + mutant phenotype","supports H3K56 AT activity (different process)",
 "N. crassa RTT109 is an H3K56 acetyltransferase",
 "RTT109 is the H3K56 acetyltransferase in N. crassa and H3K56ac is required for the small-RNA biogenesis (quelling) pathway",
 "N. crassa, in vivo",
 "High for the MF assignment. Establishes H3K56ac activity in this organism, in a process distinct from PRC2 silencing."),
("38261383","mutant phenotype (ortholog)","supports",
 "Fungal RTT109 orthologs acetylate H3K56",
 "Sordaria macrospora rtt109 phenotypes consistent with H3K56ac loss",
 "Sordaria macrospora, a close Sordariomycete relative",
 "Moderate. Ortholog evidence, used for corroboration only."),
("18458063","direct assay (in vitro HAT)","competing / mechanistic background",
 "Chaperone identity selects the Rtt109 site",
 "Vps75-bound Rtt109 acetylates H3K9 and H3K27; Asf1-bound Rtt109 acetylates H3K56",
 "S. cerevisiae, recombinant proteins in vitro",
 "High in yeast, but in vitro and not transferable: the N. crassa Vps75 homolog NAF-2 is dispensable for the phenotype."),
("21256037","structural / direct assay","competing / mechanistic background",
 "Rtt109 site selection has structural determinants",
 "Rtt109-Vps75 structure and specificity analysis define the chaperone interface and the K290 autoacetylation requirement",
 "S. cerevisiae, crystallography and in vitro HAT",
 "High in yeast. Supplies the determinant list used in the mapping below."),
("structural/evolutionary (this work)","computational: pairwise global alignment","qualifies",
 "Specificity determinants constrain which site N. crassa RTT109 can use",
 "Q7S1R7 vs Q07794: 34.2% identity over 371 aligned columns. Catalysis 6/6 identical (D145, R192, Y197, W226, D304, D305), autoacetylation K307 identical, acetyl-CoA contacts 4/7 identical with R97/R101 unaligned, Vps75 interface 4/9 non-conservative",
 "UniProt sequences, Needleman-Wunsch BLOSUM62 gap -11/-1",
 "High for the catalytic core: the mapping blindly recovers D145, D304 and D305, the exact residues mutated in PMID 42832562. The donor-side determinants are shared by all candidate reactions and so carry no site information."),
("structural/evolutionary (this work)","computational: substrate sequence comparison","refutes the sequence-context approach",
 "Candidate non-H3K56 sites can be ranked by surrounding sequence context",
 "N. crassa H3 (P07041) and S. cerevisiae H3 (P61830) are 136 aa, 94.9% identical, no indels; the +/-6 windows at K4, K9, K14, K18, K23, K27 and K36 are character-for-character identical; only the K56 window differs (F54Y)",
 "UniProt sequences",
 "High. The substrate side carries zero discriminating information between the two species."),
("computational (this work)","computational: structure confidence","qualifies",
 "A predicted structure can localise the determinants",
 "AF-Q7S1R7-F1 v6 global pLDDT 69.1; catalytic/autoacetylation mean 93.9; acetyl-CoA contacts mean 93.8; Vps75-equivalent mean 83.7; C-terminal Asf1-equivalent mean 47.3 (residues 600-630 mean 33.6); D305 CG to K307 NZ 3.6 A",
 "AlphaFold DB prediction, no experimental N. crassa RTT109 structure exists",
 "Catalytic core assignments reliable; the C-terminal Asf1-tail assignment is not, given pLDDT below 50."),
("database (this work)","review/database","qualifies",
 "Current GO annotation reflects the N. crassa evidence",
 "All 9 QuickGO annotations on Q7S1R7 are IEA or IBA with no experimental evidence code, including GO:0032931 histone H3K56 acetyltransferase activity (IBA, GO_Central)",
 "QuickGO REST, retrieved this run",
 "High as a database snapshot. Experimental N. crassa evidence from PMID 24554705 and PMID 42832562 is not yet captured."),
]
ev=pd.DataFrame(EV,columns=["citation","evidence_type","direction","claim_tested","key_finding","context","confidence_and_limitations"])
ev.to_csv("evidence_matrix.csv",index=False)
print("evidence_matrix.csv rows:",len(ev))

GO=[
("GO:0032931","histone H3K56 acetyltransferase activity","MF","IBA (GO_Central)",
 "make more specific / upgrade evidence",
 "Retain and strengthen. PMID 24554705 gives direct N. crassa experimental support (IDA/IMP) for H3K56 acetyltransferase activity; the current IBA understates the evidence. PMID 42832562 does not refute the activity, only its sufficiency for PRC2 silencing."),
("GO:0010484","histone H3 acetyltransferase activity","MF","IEA (InterPro IPR016849)",
 "retain",
 "Retain as the correct parent. It is the appropriate term if a curator wants a site-agnostic MF that accommodates an unidentified second site."),
("GO:0004402","histone acetyltransferase activity","MF","IEA (RHEA)",
 "retain (redundant parent)",
 "Retain; redundant with GO:0010484 but harmless."),
("GO:0043992","histone H3K9 acetyltransferase activity","MF","not annotated",
 "do NOT add",
 "Unsupported in N. crassa. The yeast route to H3K9ac is Vps75-dependent (PMID 18458063) and NAF-2 is dispensable for the N. crassa phenotype (PMID 42832562). No N. crassa H3K9ac measurement exists."),
("GO:0044017","histone H3K27 acetyltransferase activity","MF","not annotated",
 "do NOT add",
 "Same reasoning as GO:0043992. Tempting because the phenotype is an H3K27me3 defect, but H3K27ac was never assayed and the chaperone route is excluded."),
("GO:0036408","histone H3K14 acetyltransferase activity","MF","not annotated",
 "do NOT add",
 "No evidence in any fungus linking RTT109 H3K14ac to PRC2 silencing; never assayed in N. crassa."),
("GO:0140718","facultative heterochromatin formation","BP","not annotated",
 "ADD (lead)",
 "Strongest new-term lead. PMID 42832562 shows RTT109 is required for the structure and function of PRC2-methylated chromatin, with catalytic-dead alleles failing to rescue. Evidence code IMP. Consider whether 'maintenance' rather than 'formation' is the better fit, since the paper frames the role as epigenetic maintenance over mitoses."),
("GO:0045814","negative regulation of gene expression, epigenetic","BP","not annotated",
 "ADD or use as the safer alternative (lead)",
 "Supported by derepression of H3K27me3-marked genes in delta-rtt109 (PMID 42832562). Less specific than GO:0140718 but makes fewer commitments."),
("GO:0040029","epigenetic regulation of gene expression","BP","not annotated",
 "consider as parent",
 "Appropriate if a curator judges GO:0140718 and GO:0045814 both too strong."),
("GO:0006338","chromatin remodeling","BP","IEA",
 "generalize or remove",
 "Carry-over from InterPro. RTT109 is an acetyltransferase, not a remodeler. Treat as non-core; GO:0006325 chromatin organization is the defensible parent."),
("GO:0006974","DNA damage response","BP","IBA",
 "retain, upgradeable",
 "PMID 42832562 reports delta-rtt109 and both hH3 K56 mutants are MMS-hypersensitive in N. crassa, which would support an IMP upgrade."),
("GO:0030422","siRNA processing","BP","not annotated",
 "consider (lead)",
 "PMID 24554705 reports H3K56ac is essential for the small-RNA biogenesis pathway in N. crassa. A curator should check whether the RTT109 requirement is direct enough for a BP annotation or is a downstream consequence."),
("GO:0005634","nucleus","CC","IBA + IEA",
 "retain, upgradeable",
 "Chromatin-templated function and FLAG co-IP from chromatin-associated extracts are consistent; a curator could seek a direct localization result."),
("GO:0042393","histone binding","MF","not annotated",
 "do NOT add on current evidence",
 "No direct histone-binding assay for N. crassa RTT109. Preferred over 'protein binding' if a binding term were ever needed, but the catalytic MF terms are more informative."),
]
go=pd.DataFrame(GO,columns=["go_id","term","aspect","current_status_on_Q7S1R7","recommended_action_lead","rationale"])
go.to_csv("go_decision_table.csv",index=False)
print("go_decision_table.csv rows:",len(go))
pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",60); pd.set_option("display.width",220)
print(go[["go_id","term","aspect","current_status_on_Q7S1R7","recommended_action_lead"]].to_string(index=False))

# --- figure: logical structure of the exclusion argument, built from the tables above ---
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,5.6))
cands=["H3K56ac","NAF-2 (Vps75) route","ASF-1 route","H3K9ac","H3K14ac","H3K18ac","H3K23ac","H3K27ac","non-histone substrate"]
status=["excluded","excluded","not detected","untested","untested","untested","untested","untested","untested"]
col={"excluded":"#d6604d","not detected":"#999999","untested":"#4393c3"}
ypos=np.arange(len(cands))[::-1]
ax.barh(ypos,[1]*len(cands),color=[col[s] for s in status],edgecolor="k",lw=.6)
ax.set_yticks(ypos); ax.set_yticklabels(cands,fontsize=10)
ax.set_xticks([]); ax.set_xlim(0,1.9)
notes=["hH3 K56R and K56Q do not phenocopy (PMID 42832562)",
       "delta-naf-2 does not phenocopy (PMID 42832562)",
       "no co-IP signal; crosslinking not used (PMID 42832562)",
       "zero mentions in 120,120 chars of full text","zero mentions","zero mentions","zero mentions","zero mentions",
       "no acetylome / PTM mass spectrometry reported"]
for yy,n in zip(ypos,notes): ax.text(1.05,yy,n,va="center",fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_title("Candidate routes by which N. crassa RTT109 catalysis could support PRC2-repressed chromatin\n"
             "catalysis is required (rtt109 D145A and D145A-DD304-305AA fail to rescue H3K27me3), the product is not identified",fontsize=10.5)
h=[plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1,fc=c,ec="k",lw=.6) for c in col.values()]
ax.legend(h,list(col.keys()),loc="lower right",fontsize=9,framealpha=.95)
for s in ["top","right","bottom"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
